entities.summary: Otto Willmann was a German philosopher and educator, in the tradition of Johann Friedrich Herbart. A devout Catholic, Willmann was the leading German Catholic scholar in education of his time. He taught at the German University of Prague from 1872 until 1905. Willmann was a contributor to the Catholic Encyclopedia. In the history of ideas, he is also known for rediscovering Agostino Steuco's work De perenni philosophia.
